spec.command:
set -o pipefail
VOL='vol --offline -s /tmp/dfirswarm-batman-ii-preparation/home/packs/memory-forensics/vendor/symbols -f inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw'
mkdir -p "$OUT/proc"
cd "$OUT/proc"
$VOL windows.memmap.Memmap --pid 3768 --dump > ../memmap.txt
DUMP=$(find . -type f | head -1)
echo "dump=$DUMP" > ../dump-info.txt
ls -l "$DUMP" >> ../dump-info.txt
strings -a -t d -n 4 "$DUMP" > ../proc-ascii.txt
strings -a -e l -t d -n 4 "$DUMP" > ../proc-utf16.txt
grep -Eai 'keepass|password|master|user(name)?|\.kdbx|key|deleted|recycle|version' ../proc-ascii.txt > ../proc-ascii-hits.txt || true
grep -Eai 'keepass|password|master|user(name)?|\.kdbx|key|deleted|recycle|version' ../proc-utf16.txt > ../proc-utf16-hits.txt || true
cat ../dump-info.txt
head -200 ../proc-ascii-hits.txt
head -200 ../proc-utf16-hits.txt

requester.name: Vault Artifact Analyst
requester.doing: Establishing Q3-Q4: password-manager identity/version and password, plus the deleted stored user key.
